name: st-corporate-income-tax
description: Use this skill for tax year 2026 working papers in Sao Tome and Principe (STP, jurisdiction ST). It covers IRC scope, residents on worldwide profit, Group 1 (organised accounts) and Group 2 (simplified) regimes, the 25% general rate, 20% withholding on royalties, capital income, board fees, prizes and services, five-year loss carry-forward, the 50% agricultural exemption, payments on account in June, September and December, returns by 30 April or in February, the minimum tax of 2 per 1000 of turnover with a Db 2,400 floor voted on 11 February 2026 (held: the published 2026 law was not read), returns by exempt bodies, billing software and the cash limit under the 2025 Budget Law (2026 not confirmed), the held Group 1 threshold, and the incentive rates that remain held. Trigger phrases: Sao Tome corporate tax, IRC Sao Tome, STP company tax, Direccao dos Impostos, dobras, imposto sobre o rendimento de pessoas colectivas.
